item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: StatSpace 1.2.0
item.description:
macOS menu bar system monitoring

Stat Space is a macOS menu bar system monitoring tool for developers and AI programmers that supports Macs with Apple Silicon chips, macOS 14 Sonoma, or newer. The software centrally displays CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, temperature, fan, and battery status, and keeps a 30-day, minute-level history locally, making it easy to track load changes. It can integrate the auxiliary process into its own application, trace the listening port to the project directory and the startup source, identify the development process left after the end of the Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor sessions, and centrally clean up after confirmation. Users can also view AI tool usage limits, adjust volume independently for each app, check microphone occupancy, peripheral connectivity, and why sleep is blocked. The menu bar supports a variety of charts, themes, and shortcuts. It works with desktop widgets, custom home pages, network diagnostics, storage cleanup, and CLI and MCP interfaces to integrate system status and development environment management into the same interface.

item.title: Shoji 1.5.1
item.description:
macOS automatic window tiling

Shoji is an automatic window tiling management tool for macOS 15 Sequoia and update systems that automatically arranges positions when opening app windows, reallocates remaining space after closing the window, and reduces repeated dragging and resizing operations. The software provides a grid, columns, branches, and side layouts. The regular screen supports one to four windows, and the ultra-wide screen supports up to five windows. When there is not enough space, the windows can be stacked in the current area. Each monitor can use a separate layout, and supports cross-screen mobile windows, portrait main window top, and main window scale adjustment. Beta Setups saves app combinations with individual screen layouts, restores the workspace with a click or shortcut, and other apps are only hidden without quitting. Users can also adjust window borders, spacing, colors, and shortcuts to make room for docks or toolbars at the edges of the screen, and exclude specified apps from tiling. Shoji supports Simplified Chinese and macOS Spaces, and automatically pauses when you turn on front-end scheduling. Window management is done natively, no screenshots, no reading of document content, and no saving of window titles for Mac users who need multi-application parallelism and multi-monitor collaboration.

item.title: Tele 1.0
item.description:
Multi-device app window sharing tool

Tele is a collaborative application window sharing tool for multiple Macs that opens the required application window on another Mac directly to the current computer, side-by-side with the native application, without the need to view the entire remote desktop. From the menu bar, you can browse windows on your paired Mac, search for a destination, or launch a remote app that isn't already running, using your current keyboard and mouse. Remote apps can appear in the Dock and App Switcher, and different Macs are labeled in their own colors, making it easy to work on tasks on multiple devices at the same time. The software supports bi-directional transfer of text, links and pictures, plays or mutes app sounds by window, and can receive remote whole machine audio through the companion components, using the native microphone for remote calls. The device establishes an encrypted connection directly within the same network, without the need for an account or a cloud relay. You can control input, sound, and clipboard permissions separately, and the password manager will not be shared. Tele also supports no-monitor Mac mini, post-disconnect window recovery, and Retina sharpness up to 60 frames per second; both ends need to be running macOS 26 or later.

item.title: Veilnote 1.2.0
item.description:
Mac Screen Share Prompt

Veilnote: Notch Teleprompter is a floating-presentation and rich-text note-taking tool for macOS that places presentations close to the camera to help users balance reading tips and natural eye contact during video conferencing, product demonstrations, virtual presentations, and screen recording sessions. The software combines a full note editor with streamlined entry suggestions to support unlimited notes, instant search, five highlight colors, image pasting and drag-and-drop, and the ability to open and edit external text files directly. The proposition bar displays the current note synchronously, providing automatic scrolling, speed adjustment, and width, height, font size, and transparency settings, as well as the ability to quickly reveal or pause playback via global shortcuts. Its screen sharing hidden feature uses macOS system-level capture and exclusion mechanism to prevent notes and remarks windows from appearing in shared or recorded screenshots and standard screenshots of Zoom, Meet, Teams, OBS and other applications. This feature requires Pro to be unlocked. The software resides in the menu bar, supports window stickiness and cross-desktop space display, and can also export notes as RTF, plain text, or Markdown, suitable for Mac users who need to view private tips while displaying.

item.title: Creative Command 2.1
item.description:
macOS Focus Timer

Creative Command is a focus timing and app site blocking tool for macOS that detects keyboard and mouse activity to bring focus time closer to engagement. The user can customize the idle decision interval. After the stop operation reaches the threshold, the timer will automatically pause and display a reminder to reduce the situation of simply waiting for the countdown to end. Software supports blocking access to interfering apps and websites altogether, using shading filters to make them less visually appealing, or allowing access to only what's needed for work. Each focus can set the duration, the strength of the constraints, and whether to allow an early end, and start through the menu bar to check the progress with the levitation timer. Statistics, continuous focus records, and session logs make it easy to review daily inputs, while pauses provide controlled space for temporary interruptions. The Plus version supports auto-starting tasks by date and time, customizing pomodoro and rest schedules, locking schedules and setting deadlines, and creating an unlimited number of presets for establishing a fixed work rhythm. The software does not require registration, does not use artificial intelligence, the developer declares that it does not collect app data, and requires macOS 14.6 or later.

item.title: MoePeek 0.21.0
item.description:
macOS Scribe Translation Software

MoePeek is a macOS native menu bar translation tool developed using pure Swift 6. It supports crossword translation, screenshot OCR translation, clipboard translation, and manual input. It is suitable for reading foreign language web pages, processing documents, and daily cross-language communication. Smart Translation mode gives priority to reading the selected text. When the selection is not obtained, the clipboard snapshot saved when triggered is used. If both are empty, the input interface is opened. The software integrates with Google, Bing, DeepL, Baidu, Youdao and other translation services, and also supports OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek and local models through Ollama and LM Studio. In macOS 15 and above systems, Apple Translate can be selected on the device to keep the translation processing of the service on the local machine. The software can intelligently recognize fourteen languages and automatically switch the translation direction, displaying the results through a hover panel that does not preempt the focus of the current application, supporting translation reading, large model result Markdown rendering and optional rich text grabbing.

item.title: Yap 0.1.15
item.description:
Mac Local Voice to Text

Yap is a native voice dictation tool for macOS that converts speech to text on the device side through the Apple Speech framework, which is suitable for composing emails, sending messages, entering programming prompts, and other scenarios. The software resides in the menu bar. Press the default shortcut key ⌘⇧ D to start recording. A small window at the bottom of the screen will display the sound waveform and real-time transcription preview. Press the key again to paste the text into the input position of the current application and restore the original clipboard content. The user can customize the global shortcuts or trigger them with a single modifier key such as right Shift. Press Escape twice in a row to discard the current dictation. All transcripts are stored locally and can be searched, copied, and deleted; audio and text are not uploaded, no account or API key is required, and no telemetry is included. Yap uses a system-managed voice model, eliminates the need to carry a model with the app, and provides default microphone following, login startup, and menu bar and Dock icon display settings.

item.title: XnView MP 1.12.2
item.description:
macOS Photo Manager Picture Browser

XnView MP is an image browsing, photo management, and batch processing software for macOS that integrates image viewing, basic editing, format conversion, and file organization into a single workflow for everyday photo archiving, photographic footage filtering, and design resource management. The software supports more than 500 image formats and can export about 70 formats, including JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, PSD, camera raw, HEIC, HEIF, AVIF, and JPEG XL. It can also handle multi-page images and partial animation formats. Toggle between thumbnails, fullscreen, tape, and effects slideshows while browsing, comparing up to four images at the same time makes it easy to pick similar photos. Editing tools include Zoom, Rotate, Crop, Brightness and Contrast Adjustments, Auto Levels, Filters, and JPEG Lossless Transforms. Batch conversion, batch renaming, timestamp modification and metadata editing can reduce repetitive operations, and cooperate with duplicate file lookup, advanced search, embedded color profile support and contact table production to make the organization and output of a large number of images more efficient.

item.title: Motrix 2.4.0
item.description:
Multi-Protocol Resource Download Tool

Motrix for Mac is an all-around download tool. Support HTTP download, FTP download, BT download, magnetic link download, Baidu net disk resource download. Motrix also uses "Aria 2" as the core, so the download speed, multi-threading and other capabilities are almost the same as other download tools.

item.title: Tinycast 0.12.11
item.description:
Native lightweight all-purpose starter

Tinycast is a native macOS launcher for daily high-frequency operations. Press the global shortcut key to call up the hover panel from any interface, and centralize the application launch, file retrieval, clipboard, calculation conversion, window management and system control into the same portal. The software is implemented with SwiftUI and AppKit. Zero third-party dependencies, no Electron, and no telemetry data are collected. The memory occupancy is usually controlled within 100MB. The launcher supports fuzzy search and favorite sticky. You can view running apps and exit single or all apps. You can also bind a dedicated hotkey for a specific app. Press it once to switch between focusing and hiding. File search directly reuses the system Spotlight, opening files and folders in the folder selected by the user without indexing them yourself. The dictionary function reads the native dictionary and instantly interprets the input entries. Clipboard history overwrites both text and images, allowing you to search and paste back into the app you just used. The calculator performs mathematical operations, unit conversions, and real-time currency-to-cryptocurrency conversions within the panel.

item.title: Stats 3.0.26
item.description:
System monitor for the menu bar

Stats is a system monitoring tool that lives in the macOS menu bar and shows live metrics: battery level, Bluetooth device connections, CPU frequency (Intel only), CPU usage, disk usage, fan speed, GPU usage, memory, network usage, and temperature, voltage and power from various sensors. It supports many interface languages, several menu bar styles (bar chart, pie chart, line graph, numbers), customizable metrics, and alerts that play a sound or send a notification when a threshold is reached.

item.title: FanBar 0.9.0
item.description:
Mac Fan Control Tool

FanBar is a native macOS menu bar temperature monitoring and fan control tool that supports macOS 11 Big Sur and later for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that can provide readable fan data via AppleSMC. The software displays the CPU temperature, average fan speed, or a combination of the two in the menu bar, and presents the temperature change through a scrolling chart for the last ten minutes, reading the GPU, SSD, and battery temperature when the hardware supports it. Everyday use keeps macOS under automatic thermal management, and after approving a signed control service, you can set a fixed speed, or choose mute, equalize, performance, and extreme thermal presets. Each preset has an independently editable temperature and speed curve that supports CPU, GPU or SSD temperature as the basis for adjustment, and can also restore system control after a specified time. The software provides protection against high-temperature notifications, hardware rpm limits, and attempts to restore automatic control in the event of an abnormality. macOS 14 and later also adds a desktop widget to view the heat dissipation status, and the widget refresh is scheduled by the system.

item.title: Double Commander 1.2.11
item.description:
Open source two-panel file management tool

Double Commander is a free, cross-platform, open-source file manager that uses a classic two-column interface design to display two file panels side by side and support up and down arrangement, making it easy for users to browse, compare, and manage files in different directories at the same time. Inspired by Total Commander, the software adds its own design ideas while retaining the habit of working with two-panel files, and is suitable for users who need to organize files efficiently, move content between multiple locations, or perform daily directory management. Double Commander supports multiple platforms and operating systems, and is compatible with 32-bit and 64-bit processors, covering different hardware environments. The project is governed by GPL-2. 0 The license is continuously developed. The source code, build scripts, plug-ins, language files and help documents can be viewed in the public repository. Users can select the corresponding version according to their own system and obtain the latest version information through the project release page. Double Commander is an open source file management tool for multi-platform environments, with a two-column file panel as the core, providing a clear and intuitive way to manage directories, suitable for file browsing, organizing and cross-directory operations.

item.title: Harbor 1.9.1
item.description:
macOS Native Torrent Magnetic Torrent Download Tool

Harbor is a native download manager for macOS. Built with SwiftUI, the interface is close to the system experience. It is suitable for Mac users who need to centrally manage multiple download tasks. It supports HTTP and HTTPS direct downloads, can also handle public media links, magnetic links, and local torrent files, and provides a preview of the torrent file list before starting, making it easy to select what you really need. The software emphasizes local-first and privacy-friendly, does not rely on account, login, or hosting backends, and the download queue, history, and task status are all designed around native workflows. Harbor provides batch addition, speed control, traffic configuration, pause recovery, retry cancellation, Finder display, Quick Look preview, seed monitoring folders, seeding control, and sharing rate limitation, which are suitable for daily file downloads as well as media and seed task management.

item.title: Easydict 2.17.3
item.description:
Scribe Translation and Screenshot Translation Tool

Easydict is a simple and elegant macOS dictionary translation app designed to make it easy for users to find words and translated text, out of the box, and support offline OCR recognition. It can automatically recognize the language of the input text, supports input translation, transcription translation, and OCR screenshot translation, and can query multiple translation services at the same time, including dictionaries, Apple system dictionaries, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepL, Google, Bing, Tencent, Baidu, Mavericks, Caiyun, and Volcano translation. Easydict supports 48 languages, easy to use, users can configure different services according to different windows, and enjoy intelligent query mode and system text reading service. Easydict is a concise and elegant macOS dictionary translation app that makes it easy to find words and translate text. The app works out of the box, supports offline OCR recognition, and can automatically recognize the language of the input text to provide users with a more convenient translation experience. Out of the box: Users can get started quickly and query words and translated texts without the hassle of setting up. Automatic language recognition: It can automatically recognize the input language and intelligently match the target preference language.

item.title: Rockxy 0.42.0
item.description:
macOS Native HTTPS Network Scraping Debug Agent

Rockxy is a native macOS network debugging proxy application, built with Swift SwiftUI AppKit and SwiftNIO, that intercepts, checks, and modifies HTTP HTTPS WebSocket GraphQL traffic as a local preferred AGPL open source community alternative for Proxyman and Charles Proxy. It supports capturing traffic from any Mac application command-line tool or iOS device and emulator, provides multi-field filter full-text search for reusable Focus Sets and workspace noise control, the built-in AI assistant can call models such as Ollama for selected requests to perform local evidence analysis or confirmed by Review Data, and opens a local MCP server for Claude Desktop or Cursor to query traffic through ten read-only tools.

item.title: IPTVnator 0.25.0
item.description:
Cross-platform IPTV player

IPTVnator is a video player application that supports the playback of IPTV playlists (m3u, m3u8). Users can import playlists or upload local files via a remote URL. It also supports EPG information in XMLTV format, which can be provided via a URL. The application is a cross-platform open source project built on Electron Tauri and Angular. It is important to note that IPTVnator does not provide any playlists or other digital content, and the channels and pictures in the screenshots are for demonstration purposes only. IPTVnator features include support for M3u and M3u8 playlists, Xtream Code (XC) and Stalker Portal (STB) support, external player support (e.g. MPV, VLC), adding playlists from a file system or remote URL, automatically updating playlists when the app launches, channel search functionality, EPG support (TV Guide) and details, TV lookback/lookback/timeshift functionality, group-based channel lists, favorite channel management, Global collection of all playlists, support for HLS.js or Video.js-based HTML video playback…

item.title: AndroidFileSync 2.3.3
item.description:
wireless File Transfer for macOS and Android

AndroidFileSync is a native macOS Android file transfer and application management tool built with SwiftUI. It supports the transfer of files between Mac and Android devices via USB or WiFi within the same local area network, without the need for cloud transfer, Google account or mobile companion apps. The software provides Finder-like sidebar navigation to browse the phone's internal storage and external SD cards, upload files and folders by drag-and-drop, and supports parallel uploads and downloads, automatic bandwidth management, and space bar for quick preview of images, videos, and PDFs. File management features include copy and paste, batch renaming, modifying extensions, trash recovery, and renaming conflict reminders for easy organizing of your phone's data. The built-in application manager can classify and view applications, install APK, XAPK, APKS and other installation packages, backup APKs, uninstall user applications, and disable or re-enable system applications without root. Wireless connectivity supports QR code pairing, auto-discovery, and manual filling of connection information, as well as the ability to connect multiple devices and switch management.

item.title: Tuck Pro 1.4.14
item.description:
Hide menu bar icons on Mac

Tuck is a native menu bar organizer for macOS 14 to 27 that tidies up the growing pile of app and system icons. In Push mode, one click hides the menu bar icons to the left of Tuck and another click restores them; on notched MacBooks, hidden items appear in a Shelf panel below the menu bar. You can drag icons to reorder them, set each to always show, always hide or follow the main toggle, and control it with shortcuts. Pro adds auto-hide, show-on-hover, per-app visibility rules and Shelf customization. It is under 10 MB with no telemetry; the free version has no time limit and Pro is a one-time license for up to three Macs.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.27
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: BetterMouse 1.7
item.description:
macOS Mouse Enhancer

BetterMouse is a utility designed for macOS to improve the performance and functionality of external mice. It is a lightweight, efficiency-optimized tool designed to replace resource-intensive mouse drivers such as Logitech Options. It provides an ultra-smooth scrolling effect, and users can fully configure parameters such as scrolling time, direction, and acceleration. It also provides precisely configured discrete scrolling that enables or disables shift-scrolling to the horizontal direction and can be translated via any button for free scrolling similar to a trackpad. BetterMouse also provides independent cursor acceleration and speed controls that completely eliminate acceleration, as well as accurate mouse frame rate counters. Users can map each additional button click/drag/long press to any keyboard shortcut and a large number of special actions. Each application has its own scroll settings and button/gesture mapping settings. BetterMouse is a secure and clean menu bar application that requires no custom network access, no file access, no extensions, drivers, daemons or agents, and minimal CPU and power usage.

item.title: ScreenCam 1.5.0
item.description:
macOS Lightweight Native Screen Recorder

ScreenCam: Screen Studio is a screen recording and post-editing tool for macOS that makes product presentations, software tutorials, course content, and social media videos. It enables the recording of entire screens, single windows, or custom areas, and captures both system audio and microphone sounds, allowing for complete preservation of narrative, operational steps, and interface changes. After recording, users can continue to work on frame composition, zoom animations, cursor styles, background effects, and playback rhythms in the same editor without having to switch to other editing software frequently. The background can be wallpaper, solid color, custom image or video, and the aspect ratio and export effect can also be adjusted according to the publishing platform. ScreenCam: Screen Studio puts more emphasis on the efficiency of finishing, beautifying and presenting after screen recording, helping ordinary operation records quickly become clear, clean and rhythmic video works.

item.title: Tangerine 2.0.4
item.description:
macOS File Format Quick Converter

Tangerine: File Converter is a macOS file conversion and processing tool that integrates Finder drag-and-drop operations. In the menu bar, hold down Shift to drag the file to call up the formatting carousel around the pointer. After releasing, save the converted copy next to the original file; hold down Option and Shift to adjust the processing tool for the current file type. The software supports multiple formats such as pictures, videos, audio, documents, subtitles, and compressed archives, and adds support for EPUB, Word, Pages, PowerPoint, and spreadsheets. All file processing is done locally on the Mac, no need to upload files, suitable for private photos and sensitive documents. Built-in image cropping, tagging, and masking, video clipping, shifting, and scraping, audio standardization, muffling, and channel adjustment, and PDF merging, splitting, and page rearrangement, while compressing files by target size or percentage. Multiple compatible files can be dragged into a batch at once, view the task through a small progress window, and locate the result in the Finder after completion.

item.title: myPDF 2.0.1
item.description:
Versatile PDF Editing Toolbox

myPDF – Scan, Fill, Sign & OCR is a powerful AI-driven PDF scanner and editor that supports iPhone, iPad and Mac platforms. myPDF provides professional-grade document scanning, OCR text recognition, PDF editing, filling signatures, merge splitting, annotation, watermarking, password protection, and intelligent chat with PDF to help users efficiently manage business documents, study notes, and daily documents. myPDF runs completely offline with 100% privacy and security, no account login required, no data collection, no ad interference, and one-time purchase for permanent use of all advanced features. myPDF uses intelligent scanning technologies such as automatic edge detection, fluoroscopy correction, and shadow cleaning to scan multiple pages in bulk and generate high-quality searchable PDFs. myPDF's built-in multilingual OCR supports more than 13 languages, accurately extracting text and preserving the original layout format, making static images instantly editable and searchable documents.

item.title: Launchie 1.6.4
item.description:
macOS26 Launchpad Replacement Tool

Launchie is a fast and efficient app launcher designed for macOS users to improve the efficiency of their workflows. It provides a beautiful and smooth interface that makes it easier to browse and open applications. Whether you're a power user or someone looking for a cleaner desktop, Launchie offers easy access and a better way to organize. With instant access, the app launcher lets users quickly open Launchie with ⌘ + K or a custom shortcut, and can find and launch any app in seconds with a smart search. Users can rearrange apps by drag-and-drop, use folders to keep workspaces tidy, and support backup and restore settings. Launchie also includes smart list displays of recently used, most commonly used, or latest apps, rich appearance customization options that allow users to adjust as needed, and a modern liquid glass interface or traditional form look. Designed with speed, simplicity, and personalization in mind, Launchie is perfect for users looking for a smarter, faster, and personalized launch experience.

item.title: Sortroom 1.0.1
item.description:
macOS photo management software

Sortroom is a photo and video management software for macOS 26 and later. It directly reads existing folders on your Mac, portable SSD, and external hard drive, allowing you to browse common image formats, camera RAW files, videos, and Live Photos without importing them into your gallery. The software combines local photo recognition, intelligent categorization, and shooting time and location information to help organize years of accumulated materials. You can also create custom locations based on GPS range, allowing new and old photos to be automatically placed in the corresponding locations. Through statuses such as pending publication, planned publication, published publication, and pending editing, users can filter materials, arrange the carousel order, and record social media platforms, accounts, dates, and captions. The published log is for record-keeping only and does not automatically upload content. Batch renaming, folder archiving, and duplicate material cleanup all offer previews or manual confirmation, support undoing, and do not resave or compress photos. Tags can be carried with the hard drive or managed via a private iCloud sync. The software runs photo recognition on the device by default, requiring no account registration.

item.title: AnySearch Pro 3.5.5
item.description:
File search tool for macOS

AnySearch Pro is a fast file search and disk content analysis tool for macOS that uses smart indexing and full-text search to find files among hundreds of thousands. A global hotkey opens a floating search panel from any app, and you can search by contains, prefix, suffix, exact match or wildcard. It supports combined filters (extension, type, size, modified date, folder scope, disk source) and searches the text of PDF, Markdown, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, highlighting matches in snippets. Results support quick preview, opening, revealing in Finder, and copying names or paths. Real-time file system monitoring keeps the index current, including iCloud Drive and external USB and Thunderbolt disks.

item.title: OnDevice OCR Pro 3.4.3
item.description:
Batch OCR tool for documents on macOS

OnDevice OCR Pro is an offline OCR and batch document processing tool for Mac that turns scans, images and PDFs into full-text searchable content. It runs entirely on your Mac with no cloud or subscription, so sensitive files stay local, which suits legal, medical, financial and office use. It can watch folders and process new documents automatically, with batch recognition, auto-rotation, image enhancement and smart skipping of already digital PDFs. Built-in multilingual OCR covers Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German and more, and it can extract text only to save disk space. It is well suited to invoices, receipts, contracts and research material.

item.title: Structured 4.6.8
item.description:
Intelligent scheduling planning tool

Structured, an app that helps users stay in control of their daily lives by bringing together calendars, to-dos, routines, and habits through a clear visual timeline, has attracted more than 1.5 million active users, making them feel calmer, more focused, and able to efficiently complete their daily tasks. Perfect for work, study, travel, and busy ADHD thinking, the app takes just a few minutes to plan and stay focused throughout the day. Users can intuitively organize daily and weekly tasks, capture ideas at any time and organize them later, sync between iPhones, iPads, Apple Watches, and Macs, split large projects into notes and subtasks, and have a pomodoro focus timer, real-time activities, and interactive widgets to help keep users on track. Users can also personalize their schedule with color coding and hundreds of icons, and enjoy accessibility features like VoiceOver, voice control, friendly fonts, and multilingualism.

item.title: Bob Pro 专业版 1.21.3
item.description:
powerful crossword AI translation tool for macOS

Bob is a convenient translation and OCR tool software with a variety of features to meet the needs of users. Its translation functions include crossword translation, screenshot translation, input translation, and translation using the PopClip plug-in. It also supports multi-open translation and word search functions, allowing users to save translation history and collect translation results against multiple translation services. In terms of OCR function, Bob can quickly identify text through screenshots, support silent screenshot OCR and access selection recognition. Offline recognition function is available for macOS 11 and above systems. Bob also has QR code recognition and intelligent segmentation function, and automatically copies the recognition results to the clipboard. Bob is a handy translation and OCR tool that integrates a variety of useful features to help users easily translate text and recognize image characters. Script Translation: Select the text you want to translate and press the Script Translation Shortcut (default + D) to translate quickly. Screenshot Translation: Press the Screenshot Translation shortcut (default aves + S) to intercept the area that needs to be translated.

item.title: Mockup 4.6.2
item.description:
Interactive Prototyping Tool

Mockup is the ultimate UI/UX design tool for iOS that helps you bring your boldest ideas to life. Whether you're conceiving your next app or web design, Mockup allows you to smoothly draw with Apple Pencil, create detailed wireframes, and build interactive prototypes, all in one app. It brings together more than half a million designers, developers and team managers around the world to become a trusted tool in their design process. With a flexible canvas, over 45 device frames, and support for portrait and landscape displays, Mockup makes it easy to customize your grid, frame, and background colors to achieve your design vision. With a variety of drawing tools and a full-tone palette, you can easily draw shapes, using shape detection and alignment tools to ensure accuracy. In addition, Mockup has wireframing capabilities that enhance your design with elements from a library of presets, custom text styles, and the use of more than 4,000 symbols from Apple's SF Symbols library. It allows real-time collaboration, and users can create prototypes and export high-quality PDF or PNG files for easy sharing and collaboration.

item.title: TabBarForPowerPoint 2.2.3
item.description:
PowerPoint Multi-Window Management

TabBar is a productivity tool for the Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Supplemental Documents tab bar for macOS that displays the currently open collection of documents, workbooks, and presentations above the active window, quickly switching files by clicking on the tab, eliminating the need to repeatedly expand the window menu, use the Dispatch Center, or find files in a list. The tab bar automatically follows the active Office window, fits when you move or resize the window, appears only when the app is in focus, and automatically hides when you leave Office to reduce distractions to your desktop space. The user can drag the handle on the right to adjust the width of the tab bar, the settings will be preserved at the next start, and the shortcut keys can be used to quickly display or collapse. The software resides in the menu bar, does not occupy a docking location, does not install plug-ins to Office, and supports on-demand setup login startup. It reads only the name of the open file and places the selected window in the foreground, without reading, modifying or uploading the content of the document, without registering an account or logging in.
